description: Use this when a seller is choosing a supplier for a product type (t-shirts, hoodies, mugs, wall art, stickers or phone cases) and their shop: where buyers are, the platform, whether they need custom branding, want to start free, or want to choose their print provider. Returns suppliers that fit, that need a check, and that don't, each with dated reasons and sources, plus a delivered price range for an example product. No AI ranking.

destination.description: The buyer's country, where the order ships. Product cost, shipping and duty depend on it.

needsCustomBranding.description: The seller wants their own branding on packaging, labels or inserts.

offset.description: How many results to skip. Pass nextOffset from the previous page.

productType.description: What the seller wants to sell.

salesChannel.description: Where the seller sells. Leave out if they haven't decided.

shopLocation.description: The country the seller's shop is based in, for platform fees. Leave out if they haven't said.

wantsFreeStart.description: The seller wants to start without a monthly fee.

wantsToChooseProvider.description: The seller wants to pick the print provider that makes each order.
